_comment: Safety thresholds. Edit these numbers to tune the traffic lights. Values at or above 'red' are red; at or above 'amber' are amber.

rain_mm_per_hr._comment: Rain alone is amber when heavy. Light rain still counts in combinations once it reaches 'combo_min'.

darkness._comment: Sun angle in degrees. Below -6 (civil twilight) counts as dark. Dark alone = amber (lights required); dark + fog or dark + rain = red (see combinations).

tide_ebb_m_per_hr._comment: An outgoing tide alone is amber. It turns red only in combination with high river flow (see combinations).

flood._comment: River height at Keilor measured ABOVE its normal level. Green under 0.1 m above normal, yellow under 0.6 m, red from 0.6 m. 'keilor_normal_m' was the median of daily levels Jul–Oct 2026.

_combinations_comment: When every factor in a combination is active (amber, or dark for darkness), those lights become red. Add your own.
